glyph.isekai_mahou.shards.desc: Hurts the target (3) and splits it into a fan of crystal shards that keep flying forward. On Self: a burst of crystals where you look. Split = +2 shards.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crystallize.desc: Traps the target in crystal for 3s: it can't walk, jump and barely attacks. Then the crystal shatters and hurts. Bosses stay trapped 1/3 of the time.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crystal_armor.desc: For 30s: +4 armor and +2 toughness per level; melee attackers take back 30% of the damage. Inverted: leaves enemies Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.reflecting_prism.desc: For 10s, projectiles flying at the target are sent back to the shooter; enemy spells are absorbed by the crystal. Inverted: a flash that blinds enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.falling_star.desc: Marks the ground and a star falls from the sky there: 6 area damage and knockback. On Self it falls on the nearest enemy. Split = +1 star.
glyph.isekai_mahou.star_teleport.desc: On Self, blink up to 24 blocks where you look, stopping before walls. Hitting an enemy puts you next to it; hitting a block puts you there.
glyph.isekai_mahou.zero_gravity.desc: For 10s the target floats with no gravity: hold Jump to rise and Sneak to sink, no fall damage. Inverted: enemies drift helplessly.
glyph.isekai_mahou.constellation.desc: Marks the target and up to 2 nearby enemies as stars linked by lines of light. After 2.5s each star takes 5 damage, +20% per star in the constellation.
glyph.isekai_mahou.astral_projection.des: Your spirit leaves your body for 10s (spectator mode) and can pass through walls up to 48 blocks away. Then it returns to your body, same place and game mode.
glyph.isekai_mahou.black_flame.desc: 2 damage and black flames for 5s that neither water nor milk put out: they burn every second and half the damage heals you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.infernal_chain.desc: Burning chains burst from the ground and bind the target for 4s; while bound it burns and takes damage every second. On Self: chains the 3 closest enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blood_pact.desc: Sacrifice 30% of your current health to give the target +damage, +spell power and +speed for 20s. More blood, stronger pact. Inverted: steals an enemy's blood.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hell_portal.desc: Opens a fiery rift in the ground from which 2 allied imps emerge (+1 per Split, max 4) to fight by your side for 20s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.venom.desc: 1.5 damage and Abyssal Venom for 7s: damage every 1.25s that can kill and even affects the undead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ink.desc: A cloud of black ink at the target: enemies inside are blinded for 5s and lose track of whoever they were chasing.
glyph.isekai_mahou.tentacles.desc: 3 tentacles sprout around the target, grab it and drag it down for 4s, hurting every second. In water they drag it to the bottom and hurt more. Split = +1 tentacle.
glyph.isekai_mahou.abyssal_pressure.desc: 4 damage multiplied by depth: more in water, submerged, below sea level and in the Abyss (up to ×3). High pressure also slows.
glyph.isekai_mahou.abyssal_drown.desc: For 6s the target runs out of air even on land; without air it drowns every second. Works even on water breathers.
glyph.isekai_mahou.crush.desc: Gravity collapses on the target: 5 damage (7.5 if airborne), slams it to the ground and heavily slows it for 2s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mass_levitate.desc: Every enemy within 4 blocks of the target floats up for 3s and then plummets.
glyph.isekai_mahou.attraction_point.desc: Opens a small black hole that pulls enemies, items and XP within 7 blocks for 4s. The core hurts and, at the end, it implodes flinging everyone.
glyph.isekai_mahou.invert_gravity.desc: For 2.5s the target falls upward (hitting the ceiling hurts) and, when gravity returns, it plummets from wherever it is.
glyph.isekai_mahou.debris_orbit.desc: 3 blocks torn from the ground orbit you for 15s and are hurled at enemies who come close (4 damage). Split = +1 block.
glyph.isekai_mahou.erase.desc: Rips a piece of the target out of existence: 4.5 damage that ignores armor.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rift.desc: Tears open a rift in space for 6s: anyone nearby takes 2 damage every half second and is pulled in. Max 2 rifts.
glyph.isekai_mahou.banish.desc: Hurls the target through the void to a safe spot 16–32 blocks away; it arrives dazed and forgets who it was fighting. Bosses resist.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warp.desc: On Self, takes you up to 48 blocks where you look, passing through walls, always to a safe spot. Hitting someone swaps your places.
glyph.isekai_mahou.equilibrium.desc: Evens out the target's health and mana percentages: trades health for mana or mana for health. More power raises the balance point. Inverted: steals life as mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.eclipse.desc: A dark disc covers the sky over the area (radius 6) for 10s: enemies inside are in the dark, Weak, Slow and Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.duality.desc: Creates two clones of you for 20s: the light one follows you and heals the most wounded ally; the shadow one hunts enemies and weakens them.
glyph.isekai_mahou.final_judgment.desc: LEGENDARY. Rings of light and shadow hold enemies within 8 blocks for 2s; then lightning strikes each of them for 18 damage.

message.isekai_mahou.astral_projection.l: Your spirit can't stray that far from your body.
message.isekai_mahou.astral_projection.r: Your spirit returns to your body.
message.isekai_mahou.astral_projection.f: Your spirit can't leave your body right now.
message.isekai_mahou.blood_pact.too_weak: You are too weak to offer blood.
message.isekai_mahou.warp.no_space: There's no safe place to fold space in that direction.
